To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
BMP‐2 is a potent stimulator of osteoclastogenesis and osteoclastic bone resorption in vitro.
BMP‐2 stimulated bone resorption through the stimulation of osteoclastic bone resorption in vitro.
BMP‐2 stimulated osteoclast formation in vitro and bone resorption in vivo.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of bone morphogenic protein (BMP)-2 on osteoclastic bone resorption and osteoclastic cell formation.
the effects of BMP‐1 and ‐2 on the differentiation of osteoclast precusor cells.
the effects of bone morphogeneti c protein (BMP‐2) on osteoclast formation in vitro.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
BMP‐2 has a stimulatory effect on both osteoblastic and osteoclastic cells in vitro, which is consistent with its role in bone formation in vivo.
BMP‐2 is a potent stimulator of osteoclastic bone resorption.

BMP‐2 has the ability to stimulate bone resorption through direct stimulation of osteoblast differentiation and osteoclast differentiation as well as indirect stimulation of osteoclastic bone resorption.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
BMP‐2 acts as an osteoinductive factor for both bone formation and resorption.
BMP‐2 is involved in the bone resorption process in vivo as well as bone‐forming activity.
BMP‐2 is a potent regulator of osteoblastic and osteoclastic cells and that BMP‐2 may be involved in the regulation of bone resorption during bone remodeling.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the osteoclastic bone resorption is not a passive process, but rather a dynamic process that involves the coordinated action of both the osteoblastic and the osteoclastic cells.
the BMPs are not only involved in osteoblast differentiation but also in osteoclast differentiation, and that they play a key role in bone remodeling.
BMP‐2 is an important mediator of osteoclastogenesis and that BMPs may be useful as therapeutic agents to treat osteoporosis and other bone‐resorptive disorders.
